title: Marquise Drop Choker
descriptionHtml:
A clean collar with one long thought. A smooth round omega collar sits close at the base of the throat with a marquise cut stone set sideways at the front. From it, a fine chain falls about 6cm with a small pear stone halfway and another at the end.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with an open neckline so the drop falls clear.

Details

  • Collar: Smooth round omega, approximately 2mm
  • Stone: One marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10mm, set sideways at the front
  • Drop: A fine chain of approximately 6cm with one small pear stone halfway and another at the end
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
